say:0:1029405001:0.text: Look over there, Magister... Those two look super shady!
say:0:1029405001:0.source_cn: 老师，你看那边……那里有两个人，看起来鬼鬼祟祟的！
say:0:1029405001:0.male: Look over there, Magister... Those two look super shady!
say:0:1029405001:0.female: Look over there, Magister... Those two look super shady!

say:1:1029405002:0.text: Look at their clothes. They must be Syndicate guys... and they seem to be leaving the camp!
say:1:1029405002:0.source_cn: 主人，看他们的装扮，应该是黑金的商人……他们好像要离开营地！

say:2:1029405003:0.text: Let's find a way to stop them.
